description: Use when the user wants an ecommerce or DTC forecast built on customer cohorts: each month's new customers become a cohort that reorders along a retention curve, and the forecast adds the cohorts up into orders, revenue, cost of sales, marketing spend, operating income, contribution margin per order and the website traffic needed. The retention curve is either overall, built from a churn rate per repeat cycle and the cycle length (retentionCurveSource "calculated from the churn rate and repeat cycle inputs", the default), or a cohort curve entered directly: set retentionCurveSource to "manual input" and pass manualRetentionCurve, orders per new customer by month since the first order (month 1 is the first order, usually 1; 0.3 in month 4 means 30 of every 100 customers order again that month; up to 120 values, missing months are 0). Use the entered curve whenever the user describes retention month by month or has cohort data. Returns each line by month, the retention curve used (all 120 months), lifetime orders per customer and LTV. Runs the same math as Hemrock's Ecommerce Forecasting Tool spreadsheet, checked against the workbook. Send inputs with only what the user gave you; everything else takes the model's defaults, and the result echoes every input used, so tell the user which defaults mattered. Set months (12 to 120, default 48) for the length of the forecast; monthly results are arrays with one value per month, month 1 first, and the totals cover the same months. LTV counts at most ltvMonths months of a customer's life (1 to 120, default 60), whatever the forecast length. The result includes webUrl: give it to the user, because it opens this exact model in Hemrock's web version, where they can change any input and download the live Excel workbook. Free: signed in it uses no calculations; without an account it counts toward a few free runs a day.

inputs.description: The model inputs. Send only what differs from the defaults; anything left out takes its default.

additionalCostOfSales1.description: Additional cost of sales, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

additionalCostOfSales2.description: Second additional cost of sales, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

aovChange.description: Monthly change in order value. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

aovChangeTrend.description: Monthly change in that rate. -5% means the rate of change falls by 5% of itself each month. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

aovRepeat.description: Average order value, repeat customer. The workbook starts this at 80% of the new-customer value

cacChange.description: Monthly change in acquisition costs. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

cacChangeTrend.description: Monthly change in that rate. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

churn.description: Churn per repeat cycle. Share of customers who don't order again in the next cycle. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

cohortAdjustment.description: Cohort performance multiplier once past that

cohortThreshold.description: Change cohort performance after this many customers

conversionRate.description: Conversion rate. Share of website sessions that order; used for the traffic you would need. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSales.description: Cost of sales, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSalesChange.description: Monthly change in cost of sales. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSalesChangeTrend.description: Monthly change in that rate. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

growthRate.description: Monthly growth in new customers. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

growthRateChange.description: Monthly change in that growth rate. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

ltvMonths.description: Months of customer lifetime in LTV. Lifetime orders and LTV count at most this many months of the retention curve

manualRetentionCurve.description: Orders per new customer, by month since first order. Month 1 is the first order, so it is usually 1. A value of 0.3 in month 4 means 30 of every 100 customers in a cohort order again that month. Months you leave blank are 0. Up to 120 values, for Month 1 to Month 120; missing values are 0

months.description: Months to forecast. From 12 to 120. Monthly results and totals cover these months

newCustomers.description: New customers in the first month

repeatCycleMonths.description: Repeat cycle, months. Months between repeat orders

retentionCurveSource.default: calculated from the churn rate and repeat cycle inputs
retentionCurveSource.description: Retention approach. Every monthly cohort follows this curve. Build it from a churn rate and a repeat cycle, or enter orders per customer for each month yourself. calculated from the churn rate and repeat cycle inputs = Overall: churn and the repeat cycle, manual input = Cohort: enter a retention curve
enum: calculated from the churn rate and repeat cycle inputs

retentionMultiplier.description: Retention curve multiplier. Scales repeat orders after the first month for every cohort

startDate.description: First month of the forecast. YYYY-MM-DD

name: ecommerce_forecast_compute
title: Forecast an ecommerce business by cohort
